title: Harden MarkdownContent streaming renderer and update RuleEditorModal preview ergonomics
commitMessage: feat(ui): harden MarkdownContent renderer and update RuleEditorModal preview
author: agent-developer (react-tailwind-artisan)
summary: Hardened MarkdownContent in DrawerActivityStream.tsx: normalized CRLF to prevent Windows line-break desync; supported indented code fences with trimmedLine.startsWith('```'); added EOF flush for unclosed streaming code blocks with language banner; implemented safe linear non-greedy inline code parsing with 120-character ceiling, sentence boundary rejection (/[.!?]\s+/), and conversational Cyrillic prose filtering so stray backticks fallback to literal text without swallowing valid subsequent code badges; protected intra-word underscores in bold and italic formatting (!/\w/.test(prevChar)); and supported bullet lists (-, *, +, •) and numbered lists with indented bold monospace prefixes. Updated RuleEditorModal.tsx: defaults to preview mode on file load and mount; toggles between [Правка] (Edit3) and [Просмотр] (Eye); increased typography to text-sm body, H1 text-base font-bold, H2 text-sm font-semibold, H3 text-sm font-medium, and list/code text-xs; and expanded modal container from max-w-2xl mx-auto to w-full max-w-4xl px-5 py-4.
